Getting started
3 answers
How do I create a trip?

Open Account and tap Create trip, or tap + on the Trips screen. Add a name, destination and dates. Your trip opens in the Timeline.

Create trip
How do I edit my trip?

Open the trip and tap the menu button in the top right, then choose Edit trip to change its name, dates or details.

How do I switch between trips?

Open Account and tap Switch trip to pick another one. Your upcoming and past trips are listed there too.

My trips
Bookings
5 answers
How do I add a booking?

Tap + at the bottom, then choose how to add it: Upload Booking or ADD NEW BOOKING. Everything you add appears in the Timeline.

How does Upload Booking work?

Tap + then Upload Booking and choose a ticket or confirmation file. tripto.to reads it on this device and fills in what it can. Check the details before saving, because recognition is not always perfect.

How do I add a booking manually?

Tap + then Add a booking and pick a type: Flight, Hotel / Stay, Train, Ferry, Bus, Cruise, Car Rental, Transfer, Taxi, Parking, Insurance or Other. Only the essential fields are required. To plan restaurants, tours, museums and other things to see and do, use Day Plan instead.

How do I edit a booking?

Open the booking from your Timeline, then choose Edit to update its details.

How do I remove a booking?

Open the booking from your Timeline and choose Delete. Delete only when a booking was added by mistake.

Your trip
5 answers
What is the Timeline?

The Timeline is the main view of your trip. Flights, stays, restaurants, activities and other bookings are shown in travel order so you can see what is coming next.

How does the checklist work?

Use the To-do tab in the bottom bar for things you do not want to forget, such as your passport, wallet or charger. Add your own items and tap one when it is packed. Tap it again to undo.

Open checklist
Where are my tickets and documents?

Documents attached to a booking open from that booking. You can also open the trip menu and choose Documents to see your trip files. Some files are stored only on this device.

When can I use Trip Map?

Open the trip menu and choose Trip Map. It becomes available once your trip has at least two places to map, and it uses the places already in your itinerary.

What works offline?

Your cached Timeline, checklist and saved documents stay available without internet. Live details such as weather, new booking imports and opening directions need a connection.

Plan together
4 answers
Can I plan a trip with other people?

Yes. Open the trip menu and choose Plan together to invite people. Everyone signs in with their own free account — planning together never costs anything.

Plan together
What can invited people do?

You choose a role for each person. Can edit lets them add and change bookings. View only lets them see the trip without changing it. As the owner you can change roles or remove people at any time.

How do invitation links work?

Each invitation link works once and you can revoke it at any time. The person opens it, signs in with their own free account, and joins the trip.

How do I stop sharing or leave a trip?

Owners can remove people or revoke pending invites from Plan together. If you were invited to someone else's trip, open Plan together and choose Leave this trip.
